requirements.requirement: A planter cell — single cell that functions as a planter bin

requirements.requirement: Fed by a vertical water riser through the floor
requirements.evidence: riser:0,0,0 is a vertical riser through the floor in the same cell 0,0,0 as the planter bin, providing irrigation feed

requirements.requirement: Bin made for the pipe (PVC bore clearance)
requirements.evidence: hex-bin-full-drain-pvc variant selected — specifically designed with PVC bore to accommodate the vertical riser pipe passing through, confirmed meshClash clear

finish.summary: Planter cell built with vertical water riser through the floor (riser:0,0,0) and a pipe-compatible drained bin (hex-bin-full-drain-pvc) in the same cell 0,0,0. Bin filled with soil and planted with basil. House rules capped open faces and locked joints. Mesh clear and prop visible.
